5×7 oversized ''•Mara Jade & •Corran Horn & •Talon Karrde'' signed by Timothy Zahn (8/31/01), Shannon Baksa as Mara Jade, and Michael A. Stackpole. Radio Free Decipher (22 June 2001) said Decipher left the game-text box blank for those autographs.

Fair use of a promotional card photograph for identification on [[Mara Jade: Flesh and Blood]] and [[Oversized cards]]. Source: [https://www.nobleknight.com/P/2148343730/Oversized-Promo---Mara-Jade-and-Corran-Horn-and-Talon-Karrde Noble Knight Games].
